title: Play AC Online mod items file (api 2)
description: New furniture, each on a vanilla base piece (api 2). The engine also refuses a base with no model, fossils, gyroids, clothing, design pieces and pieces that become a pocket item. In the save a mod item is its base piece; a sidecar maps it back, so removing the mod leaves the base piece behind and reinstalling restores it. Generated from the mod API spec (https://playaconline.com/schemas/api.json). Do not edit by hand. Reference: https://playaconline.com/modding/reference/files/

id.description: The item's own id; its full id is <mod id>:<id>.

name.description: 1 to 16 of letters, digits, space and ' . , ! & -, starting with a letter or digit, not ending with a space.

base.description: A south-facing furniture id: 0x1000 to 0x1FFC or 0x3000 to 0x33C4, a multiple of 4.

price.description: Bells. Leave out for the base piece's price.
